title: trifolium pratense var. rotundifolium
intro: Trifolium pratense var. rotundifolium, commonly known as red clover, is a perennial plant belonging to the legume family. It is rich in isoflavones, specifically coumarin and triterpenoids, which have been associated with various health benefits, including reducing menopausal symptoms and alleviating osteoporosis. The therapeutic actions of red clover include estrogenic and anti-inflammatory effects, which may contribute to its potential in treating cardiovascular and neurodegenerative diseases. The bioactive constituents of red clover, particularly its isoflavones, have been found to have antioxidant and antiproliferative activities, supporting its use in traditional medicine for various health conditions.
